g1-implement.title: curate_corpus.py measurement script: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Dispatch constellation-implementer via run_crew.py --dispatch external to build scripts/curate_corpus.py: mechanical-only checks over skills/ (each skills/<name>/ except _shared) — per-skill SKILL.md line+word counts vs soft-budget constants; description checks from frontmatter (length, first/second-person pronoun presence, when-to-use marker presence, exclusion-clause marker presence for confusable-pair skills); invoker-tag presence (frontmatter 'invoker:' key); TOC presence for references/*.md over 100 lines; corpus-level duplication-signature shingle clustering across >=2 skills. Emits a human findings table AND --json. FLAGS NEVER GATES: always exit 0, enforced in code; an unparseable skill dir is a findings row, never a crash. NO baseline/drift diff (v2, S7). Shingle/threshold constants justified in code comments naming them curator review heuristics. Script must be testable in isolation (a --root/path arg pointing at any skills/ dir) and hand back a runnable invocation. EVIDENCE REQUIREMENT (critic C4): paste the script's real stdout AND exit code (from a run over the real corpus) into the IMPLEMENTER_RESULT — a prose 'it exits 0' is not sufficient. Wait for and integrate the IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT returned with no unresolved blockers

evidence: detectors must bite on fixtures (proven in g3)

Wait for and integrate REVIEW_RESULT.

g1-integrate.title: curate_corpus.py: integrate

postconditions.statement: script runs and existing suite green

g2-implement.title: skills/curator/SKILL.md: implement
g2-implement.imperative: Dispatch constellation-implementer via run_crew.py --dispatch external to build skills/curator/SKILL.md (SKILL.md only; no references/templates). Frontmatter: name constellation-curator; third-person description stating what + when-to-use with exclusion clauses vs its confusable pair (scout / write-a-skill style siblings); invoker: human key. Body: trigger (human runs periodic maintenance; never scheduled/agent-dispatched/code-change reaction); invariant #1 measure-before-mend (every invocation starts with scripts/curate_corpus.py); invariant #2 flags-never-gates; mend rules (mechanical verifiable-by-inspection fixes in place, git diff is the review gate, fixed linear pass, no engine checklist); route rules (design decisions become triage recommendations, never silent curator edits); outputs (CURATOR_REPORT.md + --json record, described inline); portfolio duty documented OPTIONAL and dormant until eval harness (#106) exists, no dependency on E. Register: rule-plus-why. GREEN-AT-BOUNDARY FIX (critic BLOCKER): tests/test_install_constellation.py hardcodes a 15-entry SKILL_NAMES list that a full-set install assertion compares for equality; the moment skills/curator/SKILL.md exists discover_skills() returns 16 and that assertion reds. So THIS gate must also add 'constellation-curator' to SKILL_NAMES (and any sibling exact-set assertion) — this is install-fixture maintenance forced by the new dir landing, NOT the G4 wiring feature, and it keeps g2-integrate's pytest boundary green. The confusable-pair exclusion clause names write-a-skill, which is an OUT-OF-CORPUS sibling (no skills/write-a-skill dir here) — word the clause generically so it does not imply a local skill dir. Wait for and integrate IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

g3-implement.title: golden-fixture tests: implement
g3-implement.imperative: Dispatch constellation-implementer via run_crew.py --dispatch external to build tests/test_curate_corpus.py: a golden-file test over a fixture skills/ corpus whose planted flaws DERIVE FROM real pre-#108 shapes sourced via `git show 2696769:skills/<skill>/SKILL.md` (the compliance-boilerplate / engine-invocation-string / emphatic-banner duplication shapes cluster A eliminated). Plant these authentic shingles into >=2 fixture skills so the duplication detector fires; also plant an oversized SKILL.md, a missing invoker tag, a first-person description, a missing when-to-use marker, a >100-line reference without a TOC, and an unparseable skill dir. Assert the findings/JSON flag each planted flaw. FALSIFY flags-never-gates: build a maximally-flagged fixture and assert exit code 0. A detector that finds nothing on fixtures is broken — prove each bites. EVIDENCE REQUIREMENT (critic C4): paste the `git show 2696769:skills/<skill>/SKILL.md` snippet(s) the planted duplication shingles were sourced from into the IMPLEMENTER_RESULT, so fixture provenance is auditable (T6) rather than asserted. Wait for and integrate IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

g5-accept.title: Two-sided acceptance sweep (reasoning gate — no crew)
g5-accept.imperative: Reasoning gate (crew-waiver: acceptance is my own verification plus one independent survey agent, neither an implementer nor a reviewer crew). Run curate_corpus.py over the REAL corpus in the worktree; paste the findings table. Near-quietness on the duplication detectors is necessary-not-sufficient. Then dispatch ONE independent fresh-context sweep agent (one tier down) given NEITHER the script NOR the epic fix list — just 'survey skills/ for duplication clusters of doctrine text across SKILL.md files, command-derived'. Paste its verdict. Divergence between the two is a FINDING to report (route via triage), not a failure. FLAG-CATEGORY SCOPING (critic C3): only the DUPLICATION-CLUSTER detector rows are acceptance-relevant (pass = near-quiet). The ~15 'missing invoker tag' rows and first-run description-lint rows on the OTHER skills are EXPECTED first-run noise that seeds the convention — they are explicitly NOT defects to fix this run and must NOT trigger retro-tagging or edits to other skills (fenced). Say so in the acceptance note. Attest c1 with both pasted into the acceptance note.
